JSON — fetch / axios 비교

javascript
function testData(url) {
  fetch(url)
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
          setTimeout(() => {
              setTestData(data);
              setTestDatas1([data[0] , data[1]]);
          }, 500);
      })
      .catch((error) => { console.error("Error data:", error); });
}

function testAjaxData(url) {
    axios.get(url)
        .then((response) => {
            const data = response.data; // 응답에서 데이터 추출
            setTimeout(() => {
                setTestDatas2([data[0] , data[1]]);
            }, 500);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
        });
}

FastAPI — items CRUD

javascript
const refresh = async () => {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/items`);
  const data = await res.json();
  setItems(data);
  writeLog({ action: "GET /api/items", data });
};

const createItem = async () => {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/items`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ title: newTitle }),
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  setNewTitle("");
  writeLog({ action: "POST /api/items", data });
  refresh();
};

const updateItem = async (id) => {
  const title = editTitle[id] ?? "";
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/items/${id}`, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ title }),
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  writeLog({ action: `PUT /api/items/${id}`, data });
  refresh();
};

const deleteItem = async (id) => {
  const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/items/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
  const data = await res.json();
  writeLog({ action: `DELETE /api/items/${id}`, data });
  refresh();
};
